title: actors.yml brain takes a full namespace, cli@atom
description:
## .wish

`actors.yml` `brain:` takes a full brain namespace: `$brainCli@$brainAtom`, e.g.
`anthropic/claude/code@anthropic/claude/opus/v5.5[1m]`, where the cli half picks the boot adapter
and the atom half picks the model.

## .why

the extant notation names a repl or a cli alone, so an actor cannot pin the model its brain cli
runs. the boot adapter is keyed on the cli half; the atom half is passed through to it.

## .open questions

- does `brain:` take the new shape directly, or behind the extant repl/cli notation as an alias?
- which adapters accept an atom, and what does an adapter that cannot do with one?
